name: marketing-newsletter-signup
title: Newsletter Signup
description: Compact email capture forms for embedding within marketing pages, with a simple inline signup and a centered-layout variant suitable for mid-page or footer placement.
useWhen: Capturing email leads inline on a blog, resource page, or between content sections.
Adding an email subscription form to the footer without a full contact form.
Offering a content upgrade or update notification on a product or documentation page.
avoidWhen: A full lead-capture form with name, company, and message is needed — use a contact form instead.
The page already has a newsletter CTA in the CTA section — duplicate signups add noise.
Subscribers need to select preferences or lists — use a form with checkboxes instead.
responsiveBehavior: Inline signup forms stack the email input and subscribe button vertically on small screens. Centered variants maintain their center alignment but compress padding on mobile.
accessibility: The email input must have a visible <label> or aria-label — placeholder text is not a substitute.
The subscribe button label must clearly describe the action (e.g., 'Subscribe to updates').
After form submission, provide a success confirmation that is announced via aria-live='polite'.

variants.title: Simple signup
variants.description: Inline left-aligned newsletter form with a short headline, email input, and subscribe button — for embedding in footers and content sections.
accessibility: Email input has a linked label; subscribe button has a descriptive label; success message uses aria-live.

variants.title: Simple signup (Dark)
variants.description: Inline newsletter signup form adapted for dark marketing page and footer surfaces.
accessibility: Email input and subscribe button must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark form backgrounds.

variants.title: Simple signup centered
variants.description: Centered newsletter form with a headline, short description, and email input — suited for dedicated section blocks and mid-page conversion moments.
accessibility: Centered email input must have a linked label or aria-label; heading introduces the signup context.

variants.title: Simple signup centered (Dark)
variants.description: Centered newsletter signup section adapted for dark marketing page surfaces.
accessibility: Heading, input, and subscribe button must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark section backgrounds.
